requiredFindings.title: A native ACL capture in step 3 closes the ledger before step 4
requiredFindings.failureScenario: project-registry.v2 is absent, so step 3 records IncompleteRefusal::Missing and continues. selection.pair opens, and capture_descriptor_acl_accounted returns DescriptorAclCaptureError::Io or Malformed. work.run's LedgerScope drops with WorkLedger.failed set. Reader::member returns that Err because is_failed() is true. read_members drops the registry finding, and observe returns the capture row before step 4's recheck_chain. A custody change the recheck would have sampled is never seen. A non-latching capture, of the read_bounded_observed shape, is what leaves the ledger open so step 4 still runs and the earlier failure stays the reported cause. A budget failure from the capture's own charge remains the budget row.
